A flash promotion: the markup ships the pre-discount price of 2599 and the active discount is applied in the browser. Ground truth is the discounted price actually on offer, authored by hand from the template. The browser is required, so this member legitimately differs from the rest of its own URL family, which is what makes /deals a misleading family for URL-based prediction.

The DOM and the JSON-LD block independently carry the same price of 1999. Purpose declared before implementation: a verifier that rejects on cross-source conflict must accept cross-source agreement, otherwise it would score well merely by distrusting every page that has more than one source. HTTP should be CORRECT and arm E must accept it.
